briefs.manifold-gPA98L9uQS: The question resolves Yes only if GTA VI is released to the general public on November 19, 2026 in any major market; early access or preload does not count. Take-Two's prepared remarks dated 2025-11-04 state that Rockstar announced the November 19, 2026 date (https://gameindustrylibrary.com/documents/q2-2026-prepared-remarks), and remarks dated 2026-02-03 tie fiscal 2027 expectations to that release (https://gameindustrylibrary.com/documents/q3-2026-prepared-remarks). Take-Two said on 2026-05-21 that GTA 6 had not been delayed (https://www.shacknews.com/article/149250/gta-6-release-date-confirmed) and on 2026-08-07 that fans can still expect November 19 (https://www.gfinityesports.com/article/gta-6-release-date-reaffirmed-by-take-two-after-exceptional-start-to-preorders). Rockstar announced pre-orders on 2026-06-24, per Take-Two's press-release index (https://www.take2games.com/ir/press-releases/), and a Rockstar quote reported on 2026-08-26 still pointed to November 19. Take-Two published its fiscal Q2 2027 results on 2026-11-09; a secondary report says it called GTA VI ten days away with record pre-orders (https://simulationdaily.com/news/take-two-q2-fy2027-gta5-gta6-pre-orders/), and no later-date statement was found. The base rate is unfavorable on its face: the announced date moved later in both prior instances (to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026), and no early release was found. This time the date has been reaffirmed at several late-stage points with pre-orders open and only seven days remaining, which is when delays are least common. A leaker's claim from about 2026-08-27 that the build was not ready is unverified. Rockstar's Newswire page did not render, so no primary Rockstar statement after August was read. An official delay notice, or a launch-time zone issue that moves the first release to November 20 in the relevant market, would change the answer.
